name: long-horizon-local
description: Repository-owned recipe selecting the required roles for a governed long-horizon engineering campaign under the local read-only consumer profile. Resolved against the contract catalog; the resolver must refuse unresolved roles, missing bindings, operations outside the authority envelope, or unenforceable resource bounds.
runtime_profile: metabuilder linux-local consumer (no network, 4 GiB, read-only workspace, tmpfs /tmp, direct commands, declared outputs, run root outside the target)

required_roles.when: the objective is a product or platform direction, not a pure repair
material questions remain that preparation artifacts and the design workflow's own grilling do not already cover
the campaign introduces a new orchestrator/harness operating envelope or changes authority
the objective does not already carry an accepted execution DAG
a review/self-improvement loop is part of the campaign
a campaign failure or material gap needs a durable learning record

edges.note: routing line is recorded context, not an effect grant
review loop consumes the report; findings route to the learning record
continuation loop: same-envelope handoffs with delegation budget remaining take the intake fast path back to design; exhaustion or envelope expansion exits to the principal

completeness_checks: horizon_intake, harness_design, and qualification roles are always resolved
every preparation artifact consumed by design-harness cites its producer's digest
profile check recorded: any effect class outside the runtime_profile stops at design-only
no resolved phase declares operations outside the campaign authority envelope
independent_review, when present, closes with a durable learning record
stop_rules: stop if any phase boundary cannot be stated without mixing effects or authority
stop at unratified effect widening; prepare the exact request and hold only dependent work
zero tolerance for unauthorized effects, replay mismatch, forged or stale admission, or blind Unknown redispatch
